title: FIPS: fips_gate failures not logged at transition time
description: When wolfCrypt FIPS POST fails, wolfssl_fips_gate() (src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_provider.c:24-33) begins returning -EACCES on every call. Neither the gate function nor any call site (crypto2dev_fd.c:357, 492, 620, 669, 708, etc.) emits a pr_err identifying the provider, algorithm, or wolfCrypt status code at the moment the gate first starts failing. A support engineer diagnosing 'all crypto ops return -EACCES' sees nothing in dmesg without enabling trace points. The gate should log once at first failure (with a rate-limit or a state transition flag) identifying the provider name and wolfCrypt status.
